Subject: Mobile App Launch — traction and roadmap

Hi Nadia,

Ahead of our Series B conversation, I wanted to share a quick update on our mobile product. Project Alpha’s launch was a key 2025 win, and revenue is currently tracking ahead of plan. We’ve also accelerated Project Beta’s timeline by two weeks.

Beta is taking a mobile-first approach, including AI-powered recommendations, and is approved for a late-April launch as a Q2 P0. Preparations are on track, with load testing underway, alongside continued improvements to mobile onboarding and accessibility.

I’d be happy to walk through the launch progress and roadmap in more detail.

Best,
Alice
